title: Growth Mindset Coaching Response Flow
description: Three kinds of student moment, three different right responses -- and one shared goal.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Motivation, Badges, and Growth Mindset Coaching

educational.audience: Mentors coaching students in the moment

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a description of what just happened with a student, the learner differentiates whether it calls for growth-mindset coaching, celebrating a small win, or a public recognition event.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin three-branch response flow converging on one outcome
pedagogical.assessment: Describe a moment and ask which response it calls for and why the other two would misfire.
